title: displaying the battery status of the master device on the follower device...
body: The need arose when you need to see the battery status of the master device on the follower device через xDrip Cloud. Is it possible to implement in the tab Classic Status Page, according to the type of display of the database? I have a daughter with diabetes who very often forgets to charge her phone, so it would be good if someone implemented such an idea. The periodicity of updating the battery status can be set to 15 minutes.

comments.body: It works for me, maybe engineering mode needs to be enabled?

After turning on the "Engineering mode", I also got a display of the battery level of the master device.

> After turning on the "Engineering mode", I also got a display of the battery level of the master device.

You will be able to disable engineering mode if/when this is merged: https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/pull/3803

xDrip sync follower shows the master phone battery level as of the 2024.12.17 release.

I would like to keep this issue open because I hope I can add the same for Nightscout.

@ahaarrestad has done the work and is testing this with Nightscout.  It will be added as a PR soon.

As this issue is really about xDrip Sync and this works fine with xDrip Sync, there is no reason to keep this issue open any longer.
